Variants.Content: Dorne did not bend the knee like other lands during the Age of Conquest. Deserts, mountain roads, scarce water sources, and riders familiar with the terrain made it difficult for dragons and heavy cavalry to win a decisive victory; the Dornish people avoided frontal battles and chose ambush, evacuation, hiding wells, and long-term attrition The war brought scorched earth, revenge and death that neither side wanted to forget, and also wrote the memory of "unconquered" into Dorne's identity. Dorne later entered the Seven Kingdoms through a marriage alliance, retaining the title of prince and unique legal customs. Regardless of the variability of contemporary political relations, this border memory will not disappear easily.
